responsibility: Provides the machine-description patterns for multiplication, division, and modulus on the M32C family, including signed and unsigned byte/halfword widening multiplies, pointer-mode scaling multiplies, full SI multiply/divide on capable subtargets, and combined div/mod expanders that model quotient and remainder registers together. It translates GCC arithmetic RTL into the target’s mul/div instruction set while encoding register restrictions and extension semantics required by the hardware.
